sloka: स वानर महाराजः शयानः शर पीडितः ।प्रत्युक्तो हेतुमद् वाक्यैः न उत्तरम् प्रत्यपद्यत ॥४-१९-१॥
transliteration: sa vānara mahārājaḥ śayānaḥ śara pīḍitaḥ ।pratyukto hetumad vākyaiḥ na uttaram pratyapadyata ॥4-19-1॥

translations.english: The king of monkeys lying on the ground struck by the arrow did not offer to reply after listening to Rama's appropriate answers (to his objections).
